tweets.author: thebitcoinstrategy.bsky.social
tweets.text: The numbers that matter right now: BNB is down ~6% since the hack. Bitcoin is down ~5% in the same window. The market is nervous, but BNB isn't being punished harder than the broader market. That's telling.

tweets.author: thebitcoinstrategy.bsky.social
tweets.text: Here's the nuance though: only 14 of 991 tokens could leave at first. Bitcoin, Ethereum, Tether. The big money. Altcoin holders are still locked. So the real stress test hasn't even started for most of the platform.
